scope: Common stationary Gaussian AR(1) coefficient in [0,1), arbitrary positive-semidefinite contemporaneous covariance. Fixed first min(K,8) columns; singular selected covariance gives a conservative full-set fallback. Heterogeneous persistence is outside the model.

power.target: Only column 0 has positive mean, delta times its true sample-mean standard deviation. Primary power is rejection of column 0, not rejection of any column.

partial_null.target: Even columns have positive means; odd columns are true nulls. Strong FWER counts rejection of an odd column only.

information_comparison: Old single-column cosine F set versus single-column multiscale Wilks set distinguishes temporal contrasts. Wilks scalar versus joint first-eight-column set distinguishes use of the common parameter across columns. Both keep the same alpha, beta and certified GLS cutoff. Neither pathwise nesting nor a universal power improvement is asserted.
calibration: Independent Wishart determinant ratio; integer positive/negative moments and Markov bounds. Moment search depends only on dimensions and beta. No Monte Carlo calibration, estimated covariance threshold, or formal-data tuning.
development: Conditional Gaussian predictive mixture and angular likelihood mixture were examined on separate development seeds 20261101/02 and not retained as improvements. Block Wilks feasibility used 20261103/04/05. Formal seeds are new; development results are exploratory.
uncertainty_reporting: Pointwise 95% Wilson intervals; paired normal intervals and exact McNemar p-values. Descriptive intervals are not simultaneous. Record CI widths, true-parameter coverage, boundary retention, singular fallback and certificate failures separately. G8 checks the factor coefficient only and is not a common-parameter coverage claim.
rng: NumPy SeedSequence([phase_seed,43,phase,group_id,replicate,0]); stationary Gaussian initial observations. Workers change execution order only. No invalid replicates are discarded.
snapshots: Replicates 0, floor(R/2), R-1, all shifts, each cell: regenerate data, decision masks, rational intervals and determinant-polynomial certificates. Other records receive hash, design and arithmetic verification.
